1. Parties
This synthetic agreement is between Alpha Labs and Beta Research.
2. Definitions
"Confidential Information" means non-public test research disclosed by Discloser.
3. Confidentiality
Recipient shall not disclose Confidential Information except with written consent.
Recipient shall return test materials within 10 days after termination.
4. Term
This agreement starts on 2027-01-01 and continues for one year.
5. Notice
Termination requires 30 days written notice.
6. Governing Law
This agreement is governed by the laws of Fictional Territory.
